newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR BELARUS V SCOTLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR BELARUS V SCOTLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Starting line-ups for Belarus v Scotland World Cup European group four qualifier in Minsk on Sunday:

Belarus - 1-Andrei Satsunkevich; 2-Erik Yakhimovich, 5-Sergei Shtanyuk, 4-Andrei Ostrovsky 3-Andrei Lavrik; 8-Sergei Gurenko, 7-Sergei Gerasimets , 6-Radislav Orlovsky, 9-Andrei Dovnar; 10-Miroslav Romashenko, 11-Andrei Khlebosolov.
Scotland - 1-Jim Leighton; 3-Tom Boyd, 2-Craig Burley, 6-Tosh McKinlay; 5-Paul Lambert, 4-Christian Dailly, 7-Kevin Gallacher, 8-David Hopkin; 10-Gary McAllister, 9-Darren Jackson, 11-Gordon Durie.
